content:
anya: Quick one 1 BlueBarn wants us to pin their embed shape for 60 days during their re-index. Sales wants a standard offer we can reuse. Thoughts?

mike: Pinning increases storage/serve cost. We can do a paid 60d soft-pin + an automated re-embed service.

sam: We should define bench gates for adapters vs full re-embed. Proposal: small canary (200 queries) to validate adapter recall drop <= 3%.

olivia: UI/Console change: surface 'compatibility_pin' toggle in the onboarding flow and include the TTL and quality caveats.

phil: Sales prefers one-off package: "Embed-Compat Pack" = 60d soft-pin + one-time re-embed credit (up to N docs) + SLA for rollout. Pricing?

anya: For repeatability: create a template addendum + playbook. Action: Sam run mini-bench, Mike estimate infra delta, Olivia draft modal copy, Phil draft pricing.

bench-bot: scheduled job started: job_id=bb-179270-1 (200 queries)

sam: Mini-bench results in: recall@10 delta = -1.5% (within threshold), latency impact negligible. Artifact: /bench/archive/1792708888/bluebarn-compat.json

mike: Cost delta estimate ~ $2.5k/month for their index size. I'll post details in #eng-infra.

anya: Consensus: offer Embed-Compat Pack as paid add-on, with 60d TTL, canary validation required, and clear console notice. We'll draft SOP and a reusable addendum.

phil: I'll send the package proposal to the customer today.

olivia: I'll mock the UI copy and flag it as "experimental feature".

anya: Thanks team. We'll iterate the template after first sale and log the exception in catalog policy.
